svg.aria-label: A regression harness for LLM agents. Every run is traced with OpenTelemetry and stored in SQLite; cases are checked by deterministic rules and an LLM judge; multi-turn rollouts run against simulated users with hidden goals, including adversarial personas fishing for the system prompt; a GitHub Action replays baseline against candidate and blocks the merge on a significant regression. Why it is interesting: The verdict rests on McNemar's exact test alone, with the paired-bootstrap interval reported only as effect size, because gating on both would push the real false-block rate above α. The judges are tested too: scored against a human-labelled golden set (accuracy, Cohen's κ) before they are allowed to gate.
